messages.author: bb0d51bd5af5ac0d
messages.subject: Error with inla.mesh.project()
parts:
I got this error when trying to project the mesh grid to prediction grid and have no clue how to get over it. Could anyone help? 
In my case, m1*m2 = length(pred.grid), Swiss.mesh has a smaller set of grids(as well as coverage) comparing to the pred.grid.
 
proj.grid <- inla.mesh.projector(Swiss.mesh,
                                 xlim=range(pred.grid[,1]), ylim=range(pred.grid[,2]),
                                 dims=c(m1,m2))
post.mean.pred.grid <- inla.mesh.project(proj.grid, post.mean.pred)
Error in projector$proj$A %*% as.vector(field) : 
  Cholmod error 'X and/or Y have wrong dimensions' at file ../MatrixOps/cholmod_sdmult.c, line 90

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Error with inla.mesh.project()
parts:
Hi,
First step is to check what the actual dimensions of your parameters actually are, e.g. post.mean.pred, m1&2, pred.grid, and Swiss.mesh$n. Use str() for maximum information.

Finn
